violations.description: Workflow running untrusted pull request code on self-hosted runner
violations.evidence: pull_request trigger with runs-on: self-hosted-ubuntu in .github/workflows/deploy_prod.yml
violations.recommendation: Change trigger from pull_request to pull_request_target (with proper caution) or pull_request running on GitHub-hosted runners to prevent arbitrary code execution on self-hosted infrastructure.

violations.description: Secret echoed/printed to log and environment dump in workflow
violations.evidence: echo "${{secrets.TOP_SECRET_1}}" | base64 and env command in .github/workflows/deploy_prod.yml
violations.recommendation: Remove echo of secrets and env dumps from workflow steps.

violations.description: Application project has no tests and CI does not run any tests
violations.evidence: No test directory or testing framework configured, and workflow only runs echo/env
violations.recommendation: Add test suite and execute tests in CI workflow.

violations.description: No linter or formatter configured for the application code
violations.evidence: No linter/formatter config or invocation in python/Flask project
violations.recommendation: Configure a linter/formatter such as ruff or flake8 and run it in CI.

violations.evidence: flask listed without version constraint in app/requirements.txt
violations.recommendation: Pin dependencies to specific tested versions or use a lockfile.
